hero.title: Simple, Transparent Pricing for IT That Just Works
hero.description: Whether you need a fully outsourced IT department, day-to-day helpdesk support, or business email and productivity licensing — Xorvo has a plan that fits. No hidden fees, no long onboarding calls required to see a price.
hero.helper: All prices are per user, per month, in INR, and exclude GST (18%) unless stated otherwise.

managed.title: Your IT Team, Without the Cost of a Full-Time IT Department

services: IT Helpdesk & User Support
Your team contacts our helpdesk for laptop, software, email, printer, Wi-Fi, VPN, and account issues — we handle it end to end.
Remote Monitoring & Management (RMM)
Continuous monitoring of CPU, RAM, disk, services, and network connectivity so issues are caught before employees notice them.
Patch Management
Centralized patching of Windows, Microsoft security updates, browsers, and third-party apps, from assessment through deployment and reporting.
NOC — Network Operations Centre
Round-the-clock monitoring of your internet, firewalls, routers, switches, Wi-Fi, servers, and VPN, with SLA-based escalation.
Server Monitoring & Management
Coverage for Windows servers, application servers, and cloud servers (Azure, AWS, and other environments).
Endpoint Management
Centralized management of employee devices: inventory, remote support, software deployment, patching, and policy management.
Antivirus / EDR Management
Deployment and monitoring of leading security platforms (Microsoft Defender, Bitdefender, CrowdStrike, Sophos, Kaspersky, and more), including incident escalation and renewal management.
Microsoft 365 Management

Full administration of Exchange Online, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Intune, Entra ID, MFA, and Conditional Access — including new-user onboarding, from account creation through device setup.
IT Asset Management
A live inventory of your hardware (laptops, servers, printers, network gear) and software (licenses, OS, applications).
Software Management
Installation, removal, updates, and license tracking for approved business applications.
Remote Desktop Support
Fast remote troubleshooting for Outlook, Office, applications, printers, Windows, and network/configuration issues — no on-site visit required.
IT Automation
Repetitive tasks (temp file cleanup, service restarts, patch installs, script runs, disk checks) automated across every device.
IT Documentation
A living record of your environment — firewall, ISP, backup solution, Microsoft 365 tenant, servers, devices, and critical applications — kept current for fast troubleshooting.
IT Reporting
Monthly reports covering devices, tickets, patch compliance, critical alerts, security issues, and backup status, so you always know what you're paying for.
Vendor Coordination
We deal with your ISP, Microsoft, and hardware vendors on your behalf — from raising the ticket to confirming resolution.

billingTerms: All prices listed are exclusive of GST. GST is charged at 18% as applicable under Indian tax law.
Billing cycle: Monthly / Quarterly / Annually based on agreed enterprise agreement.
Payment methods accepted: NEFT/RTGS, UPI, Corporate Netbanking, Credit/Debit Card.
Invoice payment terms: Net 15 days from the date of invoice.
Minimum commitment: Flexible 3-month or annual plans available on Managed IT contracts.
Software licensing is billed in advance per vendor terms and subject to vendor pricing changes.
faqs: Is there a minimum number of users?
For software licensing (Zoho Workplace, Microsoft 365), there is no minimum user count. Managed IT plans typically start with a minimum of 5 to 10 users to deliver maximum SLA efficiency.
Can I mix plans — e.g., Managed IT for some staff and Essential IT for others?
Yes! Managed IT plans and software licensing (Zoho / Microsoft 365) can be mixed and matched per user based on role, security sensitivity, and department needs.
What happens if I need to upgrade or downgrade mid-cycle?
Upgrades take effect immediately with pro-rated billing. Downgrades or license reductions take effect at the beginning of the subsequent billing cycle.
Are the software licensing prices (Zoho/Microsoft 365) fixed, or can they change?
Licensing prices are governed by Zoho and Microsoft official rates. If vendor pricing changes, Xorvo provides advance notification prior to your renewal cycle.
Do you offer a contract, or is it month-to-month?
We offer both flexible month-to-month terms as well as discounted annual commitment contracts with dedicated account management.
What's included in support response times?
Critical issues (such as total server or internet outage) receive a 1-hour response SLA. Standard helpdesk inquiries are responded to within 4 business hours.
